nodes.description: mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => address)) mapping a source token and chainID to the supported destination token; read by onlySupportToken and written by addSupportToken/removeSupportToken.
mapping(string => bool) tracking whether a cross-chain txid has already been unlocked; guards against replay of unlock.
mapping(address => uint256) holding the required vote count per token; written by _setThreshold and read by _vote.
mapping(bytes32 => bool) marking a proposal (hash of token/from/to/amount/txid) as finished.
mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => bool)) recording whether an address already voted on a proposal.
mapping(bytes32 => uint256) counting accumulated votes for a proposal.
Initializer granting DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender; protected by the initializer modifier.
Access hook for UUPS upgrade; restricted to onlyAdmin.
Pure helper computing the role key hash from token0, token1 and chainID.
Admin-only function registering a supported token pair/chainID in supportToken.
Admin-only function deleting a supported token pair/chainID entry.
Batch wrapper looping over arrays and calling addSupportToken; only the underlying addSupportToken enforces admin rights.
Batch wrapper looping over arrays and calling removeSupportToken.
Public function pulling tokens from msg.sender into the contract and emitting Lock.
Public function performing cross-chain release: votes, marks txUnlocked and transfers tokens out.
Admin-only entry point that forwards to _setThreshold.
Internal virtual function updating threshold[token] and emitting ThresholdChanged.
Internal virtual voting routine that increments counter, records isVoted, and returns true once the threshold is reached.
Caller-controlled address used for role checks, vote attribution, admin initialization and token transfers.
External ERC20 safeTransferFrom pulling tokens from msg.sender into the contract.
External ERC20 safeTransfer sending tokens to the caller-supplied recipient 'to'.
Low-level delegatecall to the new implementation during upgrade; reachable through _authorizeUpgrade-gated upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall.

edges.reason: initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender, so whoever calls the initializer first captures admin rights.
msg.sender is the token source of the lock safeTransferFrom and is recorded in the Lock event.
msg.sender must satisfy the onlyCrosser role check inside unlock before tokens are released.
msg.sender is written into isVoted[mid] and counted as a distinct voter, so vote weight depends on caller identities.
lock executes the external safeTransferFrom pull of funds.
lock reads supportToken[token0][chainID] through the onlySupportToken modifier and the Lock event.
unlock performs an external ERC20 transfer after voting state changes, giving the token contract control flow during settlement.
unlock invokes _vote to tally approvals before releasing funds.
unlock writes txUnlocked[txid] = true, and the whenNotUnlocked modifier reads it.
unlock reads supportToken[token0][chainID] for the onlySupportToken and onlyCrosser checks and the Unlock event.
setThreshold forwards to the internal _setThreshold after the onlyAdmin gate.
_authorizeUpgrade guards the UUPS path that ultimately delegatecalls into the new implementation.
addSupportToken writes supportToken[token0][chainID].
removeSupportToken deletes supportToken[token0][chainID].
addSupportTokens loops over caller arrays and calls addSupportToken for each element.
removeSupportTokens loops over caller arrays and calls removeSupportToken for each element.
_setThreshold writes the new value into threshold[token].
threshold[tokenTo] is read by _vote to determine the required vote count.
_vote increments counter[mid] with each approval.
_vote sets isVoted[mid][msg.sender] = true to prevent double voting.
_vote marks isFinished[mid] = true once the threshold is met.
token0 parameter drives the lock token lookup and transfer source.
chainID parameter selects the supported-token entry checked in lock.
to parameter is passed into the Lock event inside lock.
amount parameter is the value locked by lock.
token0 selects the ERC20 contract on which safeTransferFrom is executed.
amount flows directly into the safeTransferFrom call.
token0 parameter of unlock selects the token used for checks and payout.
chainID parameter of unlock selects the supported-token entry and role key.
from parameter of unlock is part of the authorization/vote data.
to parameter of unlock determines the payout recipient.
amount parameter of unlock determines the payout size.
txid parameter drives the whenNotUnlocked replay guard in unlock.
token0 selects the ERC20 contract used in the safeTransfer payout.
the caller-supplied recipient 'to' receives the external token transfer, enabling a callback into the contract.
amount parameter flows directly into the safeTransfer payout value.
txid is hashed into the proposal identifier mid inside _vote.
tokenTo selects the threshold used by _vote.
from is included in the _vote proposal hash.
to is included in the _vote proposal hash.
amount is included in the _vote proposal hash.
txid is included in the _vote proposal hash.
token parameter selects the threshold mapping slot updated by _setThreshold.
_threshold parameter is the value written into the threshold mapping.
_vote assigns the local count from threshold[tokenTo].
_vote computes the local proposal id mid from its parameters.
mid is used as the key when reading/writing isFinished[mid].
mid is used as the key when reading/writing isVoted[mid][msg.sender].
mid is used as the key when incrementing counter[mid].
the local count is compared against counter[mid] to decide finishing.
unlock stores the boolean returned by _vote in the local result.
the result flag gates the external safeTransfer payout in unlock.
_setThreshold snapshots the previous value into the local oldThreshold.
oldThreshold originates from threshold[token] before the update in _setThreshold.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter token0 only exists to resolve the supported token entry and transfer source inside lock.
Parameter chainID only selects the supportToken slot used by the lock modifiers.
Parameter to is only emitted in the Lock event within lock.
Parameter amount is consumed exclusively as the value of safeTransferFrom in lock.
Parameter token0 only drives the support token lookup and transfer target in unlock.
Parameter chainID only drives the support token lookup and role key in unlock.
Parameter from is only incorporated into the vote data and Unlock event of unlock.
Parameter to is the direct recipient of the external safeTransfer in unlock.
Parameter amount is the direct value of the external safeTransfer in unlock.
Parameter txid only feeds the whenNotUnlocked replay guard and vote hash inside unlock.
Parameter tokenTo only selects the threshold used as the vote count in _vote.
Parameter from is only hashed into the proposal id inside _vote.
Parameter to is only hashed into the proposal id inside _vote.
Parameter amount is only hashed into the proposal id inside _vote.
Parameter txid is only hashed into the proposal id inside _vote.
Parameter token only selects the threshold mapping slot updated by _setThreshold.
Parameter _threshold is only written into the threshold mapping by _setThreshold.
Local count is a temporary copy of threshold[tokenTo] used solely within _vote.
Local mid is the temporary proposal key computed and consumed entirely inside _vote.
Local result is the temporary vote outcome that gates the payout inside unlock.
Local oldThreshold is a temporary snapshot of the previous threshold inside _setThreshold.
